text.en: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

text.en: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If that unit has the ELECTRO-PRIESTS keyword, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy VEHICLE unit within Engagement Range of this model’s unit and roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds and, until the end of the phase, the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by that enemy unit is worsened by 1.
